+# later in the pipeline. Each rejected shape below is a trap: the raw

+  expect empty # foo is absent pre-parse

+eval instant at 60s sum(count_over_time({app="a"} | logfmt | label_format foo="bar" | foo="bar" [1m]))
+eval instant at 60s sum(count_over_time({app="a"} | logfmt | drop foo | foo="" [1m]))

+eval instant at 60s sum(count_over_time({app="b"} | logfmt | logfmt | foo="bar" [1m]))

+eval instant at 60s sum(count_over_time({app="b"} | logfmt | unpack | foo="bar" [1m]))
+# The first mutator after the parser can be the filter itself.
+eval instant at 60s sum by (app) (count_over_time({app=~"a|b"} | logfmt | foo > 5 [1m]))
